programmes.d: The group feels beaten after living life on the road, but must continue to trudge along in spite of the changes they have incurred.
The true motives of the Terminans come to light when Rick and the others end up in a vulnerable situation.
Rick leads a risky mission for a possible small reward when the supplies run low and the group's mistrust of people grows.
Rick and the others find themselves pitted against a nasty group but may have a plan to gain the upper hand.
Another group of survivors is introduced, and although things appear safe and nice, there is a bit of a dark side.
The group must contend with a new set of issues while out on a mission, and must push through to survive.
Stakes are high when members of the group must go on a heroic rescue mission in a previously known location.
The group is spread thin with some members holding down the church and the others on a rescue mission.
New enemies disregard rules and morals; although Rick wants to find a peaceful agreement, the enemies seem to prefer a more violent resolution.
After facing all the recent trials, a slight detour may offer the solution that the group has been seeking.
The group feels beaten after living life on the road, but must continue to trudge along in spite of the changes they have incurred.
After withstanding a spectacular storm, Rick and the others meet what appears to be a friendly person, but find themselves mistrustful.
The group has a difficult time molding to a new lifestyle, forcing them to consider whether they can be the people they once were.
As Rick and the others continue to acclimate to their new surroundings, they consider a return to normalcy.
While trying to secure a new home, Rick and his group face challenges, and question the utopia they find themselves in.
When life within the walls begins to mimic life outside, the group realizes that sheltered life may not be possible.
Daryl finds trouble while on a run; Rick and the group feel like outsiders in Alexandria, where trouble approaches the gates.
Rick and the others have a difficult time assimilating into Alexandria; a new threat arises that could bring the group closer together.
When it appears that things are starting to normalize in the settlement, a new problem arises for the Alexandrians.
A small group, including Rick, runs into hurdles while trying to return to Alexandria, and some may not make it back.
Morgan recalls his travels from King County to Alexandria, where he encountered a solo survivor who taught him a new code to live by.
The sheltered citizens inside the walls of Alexandria must face a grim reality that might be too much for them to handle; Deanna doubts her leadership.
Daryl, Abraham and Sasha encounter many obstacles and a new threat while trying to return to Alexandria.
Alexandria is finally able to begin pulling itself back together; peace is embraced between the two groups.
After a few moments of peace, trouble finds its way to Alexandria again with a threat that may be too big to defeat.
Now that walkers have shown up inside the gates of Alexandria, Rick and the other survivors are scared and outnumbered.
A simple scavenging run proves to be more tricky, when the survivors are not the only ones after a goldmine of supplies.
